title: ai-atoms prompt v1
description: A prompt atom — text a runtime injects into a model's context window. The subtype says what kind of text it is; content is the text itself, verbatim.

id.description: Namespaced identifier in the form prompt/<slug>.

version.description: Semantic version of this prompt atom.

description.description: What this prompt does and when to inject it.

subtype.description: persona = identity voice for a system turn; constraint = a rule the model must follow; format = how output is shaped; output-schema = a machine-readable output contract; refusal = what to decline and how; tool-use = discipline around tool calls; composite = a bundle assembled from other prompt atoms via `includes`.

content.description: The injected text, verbatim. For composite prompts this is the resolved concatenation of `includes`, in order.

applicable_turns.description: Which conversation turns this text may be injected into. Omit to mean system only.

vendors.description: Model vendors this prompt is written for (e.g. anthropic, openai, ollama); 'any' for vendor-neutral.

persona_ref.description: For subtype persona: the persona atom this text renders.

includes.description: For subtype composite: the prompt atoms concatenated into `content`, in order. Every entry must resolve in the catalog.

authored_by.description: Key atom ID or author identifier.

source_url.description: URL of the original source when imported from an external repository.

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle stage of this prompt atom.
